title: Page 9
lines: 再莱抱着他说什么也不撒手，“你……你要跟我回家的……”
“嗯，我答应过的。”
“你不可以回天上去……”她哭着哭着，不光是小脸都涨红了，就连耳根和至颈项也都红成一片。
“我不回天上去，这辈子我只陪着你。”顾醒忙安抚她，也知道她这反应是慌过头了。
这算什么？明目张胆的在他们面前抢人吗？
某四个没出声的同门，总觉得眼前的这一幕，刺眼得让他们很想动手熬锅龟汤补补身。
“咳咳，说好不可以骗我的……”再莱犹兀自伤心着，哭到后来又是咳又是打嗝的，就怕他会像她的父母一样不要她了。
顾醒俯身吻着她的眉心安慰，“我怎会骗你？我又不是你师门的其些人。”
这只龟也未免太阴险了……他这是拐鸾抹角骂谁呢？
某四人继续以吃人似的眼神瞪向他，偏又不敢上前去扯走噶啕大哭的再莱，因他们都知道，除非她自己愿意停下来，否则谁都哄不了她。
“不哭了，听话。”顾醒拉开她紧抱的双手，以帕巾擦去她的眼泪。
犹如夏日的西北雨，说下就下、说歇就歇，再莱在他的一句话下，马上就收了眼泪，只是还一时克制不住地抽着鼻子。
某四人当下因这神迹而看呆了。
顾醒在把某只哭花脸的花猫打点好后，这才侧首看向他们。
“我正巧有事要去黄金门一趟。”他这只龟向来最讨厌的就是拖泥带水的麻烦事了，因此他决定，就来个一劳永逸。
在场的某三人齐齐看向身份最高的三师兄…
玄灵沉声应着，“行，你跟我们走。”
于是，就在那日，顾醒抱着哭累的再莱上了路翔早就准备好的马车，在那下着大雪的早晨，他们连行李都没能来得及带，只带上了白十一塞给他的几盆兰花后，就像被押囚似的，被其四人给一路押去了位在原国的黄金门。
回到师门后，其四人稍事整顿洗漱，就忙着去再莱的房里找她，没想到却都扑了个空。
“二师兄，小六呢？”月穹拉住匆匆往后山方向走的蓬莱。
说到这个蓬菜就没好气，“陪其只龟去了佛堂。”
月穹万没想到顾醒的胆子这么大，“他……他直接去与大师兄谈了？”
“嗯。”赶时间要去看情况的蓬莱也不多说，直接以轻功跃向后山的方向。
回到师门的所有人，在听到这消息后，也如蓬菜一样，都跑去平时不敢靠近的后山去关心自家妹子了。
只是在他们来到佛堂前时，却只见到了形单影只站在佛堂门前的再莱，与正劝着她多穿一件衣裳的蓬莱而已，独独就是不见那只人见人厌的天上仙龟。
在顾醒进去里头许久后，透过门扇，大师兄那久违的声音再次泛进他们每个人的耳底。
“小六，你喜欢仙师吗？”
“喜欢。”再莱她连考虑都不必。
“可想嫁给他？”
“想。”路露说过，唯有嫁了人才能永玩在一起。
他大方允诺，“那就嫁吧。”
“大师兄！”众人皆被这突如其来的消息给吓着了，怎么也不敢相信，大师兄竟就这么简单地嫁了他们家的宝贝妹子。
“住嘴。”光只是冰冷的二字，就让那些正想抗议的师弟妹，在同一时刻统统都消了音。
没那个胆子去挑战大师兄的权威，又不想这么随便把妹子嫁了的众人，忙转头看向师门实权的掌握人。
“二师兄……”
蓬莱心底虽是同样不舍，但倒是较他们来得理性些。
“也好，嫁吧。”连大师兄也都认同了不是吗？
蓬莱凶悍地回吼，“都给我闭上嘴！”这群死孩子，好不容易自家妹子有人愿意接手负责了，他们还想把这大好的机会往外推？难不成他们还想将小六养在师门里一辈子啊？要知道，错过这个村，很可能就再没下个店了。
从头到尾，再莱没关心别的，她就只是静静看着佛堂紧闭的门扇，难得安静地站在原地一语不发，极其耐心地等着盼着，完全没有被身后的那些人给影响一丝半点。
她只是在等待着，那个会温柔对她微笑的天上仙，会在下一刻自这扇门中走出来，再次搂着她轻轻吻着她的额头。
约莫过几盏茶的时间后，佛堂的大门终于被顾醒开启，身上丝毫无损的他，在众人极度诧异的目光下，落落大方地走下台阶，并伸出两手接住飞扑至他怀中的再莱。
“仙师！”
顾醒笑笑地问：“肚子饿了没有？”
他俯身吻着她的眉心，“走吧，我也饿了，咱们去吃饭。”
犹站在佛堂前的众人，就只能眼睁睁地，看着那只大摇大摆的天上龟，竟就这么招摇地，在他们眼前揽着再莱的腰离开了后山，留下他们这群恨恨瞪着他背影的人。
那只嚣张龟……怎么就把他们家的软妹子拐走了？
没打算理会他们心中怨恨的顾醒，在回到再莱的房里用了饭后，习惯性地搂过她，替她揉揉小肚子。
“吃饱了？”
她爱困地揉着眼，“嗯……”
“小莱。”
“嗯？”被他熟悉的体温蒸腾出一身睡意的她，没骨头似的赖在他的怀里，动都不相心动一下。
他心满意足地看着她这副模样，“歇个两日后，咱们就回路国去。”
“为什么？”
“那还用说？当然是因为你要嫁人了。”
宛如高山上一颗明珠的路国，春日是很迷人的。
各种知名的、不知名的花朵，在群山遍野中烂漫地盛绽，清新的空气中更是弥漫着浓浓的兰花香味，对于这个永久定居的地点，顾醒很是满意。
侧首看了眼正在睡午觉的再莱，顾醒帮她拉了拉小被子，免得睡觉都不老实的她，翻着翻着又会着了凉。
再次回到路国后，喜出望外的路翔直接把延庆宫赐给了顾醒，欢迎他们以后就在路国定居。而没想过顾醒会又复返的白十一，则是老嚷嚷着他不干私人贴身保镖了，经常就来找顾醒闹上一回。
顾醒自书架上抽出一本他自黄金门所带来的书册，翻开第一页，仔细看起这本由蓬菜硬塞给他的“六师妹观察日志”。
就见蓬莱清俊的字迹写着——
小六在看过老三擅长的分筋错骨手后，两眼放光的直说好厉害……
小六在见识过老四，不耐烦的用板砖拍扁了刺客的脑袋后，拚命拍着手大喊好痛快……
再次写完一篇观察日志后，下笔的蓬莱，不断擦着满头直冒的冷汗。
小六她……她今年才八岁呀，瞧瞧她现下所崇拜的、向往的都是些什么？如此以往下去，那还得了？
不行，妹子的教肓不能等，他得将她快歪掉的人生赶紧导回正轨才行！
只是蓬莱才下了这个决心没过多久，很快即被残忍的现实给打败，而原因就出在，再莱那颗顽石般的脑袋。
甜美可人的再莱，什么都好什么都乖，偏偏她骨子里就是天生的屡教永远不改，无论她人前说得再如何好听，人后她还是一样的学不会乖。所以哪怕他再如何苦口婆心、再怎么疾言厉色，全都打动不了小菜那颗固执的小脑袋，而他就只能束手无策地看着，她在师兄姊们的影响下，一路走，一路歪。
“呜呜，大师兄我教不来、我教不来……”蓬莱再也承受不住内心的煎熬，直接跑去找自家大师兄哭诉。
“……去把小六带过来。”他事前也没想到，养孩子已是得心应手的蓬莱，居然会被个小娃娃给难住了
content_en:
Zai Lai hugged him and refused to let go, "You... you want to go home with me..."
"Yes, I promised."
"You can't go back to heaven..." She cried, not only her face turned red, but her ears and neck were also red.
"I won't go back to heaven. I will only stay with you in this life." Gu Xing hurriedly comforted her, knowing that her reaction was too panicked.
What is this? Are you blatantly robbing people in front of them?
Four fellow disciples who remained silent felt that the scene in front of them was so dazzling that they wanted to make a pot of turtle soup to replenish their health.
"Ahem, you said you couldn't lie to me..." Zai Laiyou was sad to herself, crying until she coughed and burped again, fearing that he would abandon her like her parents did.
Gu Xing leaned over and kissed her forehead to comfort her, "How could I lie to you? I'm not someone else from your sect."
This turtle is too insidious...Who is he talking about?
A certain four people continued to stare at him with cannibalistic eyes, but they did not dare to go forward and pull Zai Lai away who was crying loudly, because they all knew that unless she was willing to stop, no one could comfort her.
"Stop crying, be obedient." Gu Xing pulled away her tightly clasped hands and wiped away her tears with a handkerchief.
Just like the northwest rain in summer, it would fall at any time and stop at any time. At his words, she immediately stopped crying, but she could still sniffle uncontrollably for a while.
Four people were stunned by this miracle.
After Gu Xing tidied up a certain tabby cat with a crying face, he turned his head and looked at them.
"I happened to have something to go to the Golden Gate." What this turtle hated the most was the trouble of procrastination, so he decided to get rid of it once and for all.
The three people present all looked at the third senior brother with the highest status...
Xuan Ling responded in a deep voice, "Okay, you come with us."
So, on that day, Gu Xing carried Zai Lai, who was tired from crying, into the carriage that Lu Xiang had prepared. On that snowy morning, they didn't even have time to bring their luggage. They only brought a few pots of orchids that Bai Shiyi gave him. As if they were being held prisoner, they were escorted all the way to the Golden Gate in the original country by the four of them.
After returning to the teacher's gate, the four of them tidied up and washed up, then hurriedly went to Zai Lai's room to look for her, but unexpectedly they all came to nothing.
"Second senior brother, where is Xiaoliu?" Yue Qiong grabbed Penglai, who was walking hurriedly toward the back mountain.
When talking about this Pengcai, he got angry and said, "I accompanied the turtle to the Buddhist temple."
Yue Qiong never expected that Gu Xing would be so bold, "He...he went directly to talk to senior brother?"
"Yeah." Penglai, who was in a hurry to see the situation, didn't say much and jumped directly towards the back mountain with Qinggong.
After hearing the news, everyone who returned to the school, like Peng Cai, ran to the back mountain where they usually dare not approach to care for their sister.
However, when they arrived in front of the Buddhist temple, they only saw Zai Lai standing alone in front of the temple door, and Penglai who was trying to persuade her to wear more clothes. The only exception was the immortal turtle in the sky that everyone hated.
After Gu Xing went inside for a long time, through the door, the long-lost voice of the senior brother once again filled the ears of each of them.
"Xiao Liu, do you like the immortal master?"
"I like it." She didn't even have to think about it again.
"Do you want to marry him?"
"I want to." Lulu said that only married people can play together forever.
He generously promised, "Then get married."
"Eldest brother!" Everyone was frightened by the sudden news. They couldn't believe it that the eldest brother would marry their precious girl so easily.
"Shut up." Just two cold words silenced all the junior fellow students who were about to protest at the same moment.
Everyone who didn't have the courage to challenge the senior brother's authority, and didn't want to marry a girl off so casually, quickly turned to look at the person who held the real power in the sect.
"Second Senior Brother..."
Although Penglai was equally reluctant to give up, he was more rational than them.
"Okay, let's get married." Even the senior brother agreed, didn't he?
"But-"
Penglai yelled back fiercely, "Shut up!" These damn kids, finally one of their girls is willing to take over the responsibility, and they still want to push this great opportunity away? Is it possible that they still want to keep Xiao Liu in their school for the rest of their lives? You know, if you miss this village, you may never go to a store again.
From the beginning to the end, Zai Lai didn't care about anything else. She just looked at the closed door of the Buddhist hall quietly. She stood there quietly without saying a word, waiting extremely patiently, without being affected by the people behind her in the slightest.
She was just waiting for the heavenly being who would smile tenderly at her to come out of this door at the next moment, hold her in his arms again and kiss her forehead gently.
After a few cups of tea, the door of the Buddhist hall was finally opened by Gu Xing. With no damage on his body, he gracefully walked down the steps under the extremely surprised eyes of everyone, and stretched out his hands to catch Zai Lai who flew into his arms.
"Immortal Master!"
Gu Xing asked with a smile: "Are you hungry?"
"Hungry."
He leaned over and kissed her forehead, "Let's go, I'm hungry too, let's go eat."
The people who were still standing in front of the Buddhist hall could only watch helplessly as the swaggering turtle in the sky took Zai Lai by the waist and left the back mountain in such a swaggering manner in front of their eyes, leaving the group of people staring at his back bitterly.
That arrogant turtle...why did he kidnap their soft girl?
Gu Xing, who had no intention of paying attention to the resentment in their hearts, hugged her and rubbed her belly as a habit after returning to Zai Lai's room to have dinner.
"Are you full?"
She rubbed her eyes sleepily, "Well..."
"Xiao Lai."
"Huh?" She was so sleepy that his familiar body temperature evaporated her body, and she lay in his arms like a boneless body, not even moving.
He looked at her appearance with satisfaction and said, "After two days of rest, we will return to Lu Country."
"Why?"
"Does that need to be said? Of course it's because you're getting married."
Luguo, like a pearl on the mountain, is very charming in spring.
Various well-known and unknown flowers are blooming in the mountains and fields, and the fresh air is filled with the strong fragrance of orchids. Gu Xing is very satisfied with this permanent settlement place.
Glancing sideways at Zai Lai, who was taking a nap, Gu Xing helped her pull up the quilt to prevent her from catching cold from turning over and over while sleeping.
After returning to Lu Country again, Lu Xiang was overjoyed and directly gave Yanqing Palace to Gu Xing, welcoming them to settle in Lu Country in the future. Bai Shiyi, who had never thought that Gu Xing would come back, kept shouting that he would stop being a personal bodyguard and often came to Gu Xing to make trouble.
Gu Xing took out a book he had brought from the Golden Gate from the bookshelf, opened the first page, and carefully read the "Observation Diary of Sixth Junior Sister" forced on him by Peng Cai.
I saw Penglai Qingjun's handwriting saying——
After Xiaoliu saw Lao San’s skill of splitting muscles and twisting bones, his eyes shone and he said it was amazing...
After seeing the fourth child, Xiaoliu impatiently slapped the assassin's head with a brick, then clapped his hands desperately and shouted, "It feels so good..."
After finishing writing an observation diary again, Penglai kept wiping the cold sweat from his head as he started writing.
Xiaoliu...she is only eight years old this year. Look, what does she admire and yearn for now? If things continue like this, what's the point?
No, the girl's guidance cannot wait, he has to quickly get her life that is almost on the wrong track back on track!
It didn't take long for Penglai to make this determination, but he was quickly defeated by the cruel reality, and the reason was because of Zai Lai's head like a stone.
The sweet and lovely Zai Lai is good at everything and well-behaved at all times, but she is born to be a repeat offender and will never change. No matter how nice she sounds in front of others, she still cannot learn to be well-behaved behind others. So no matter how earnestly he spoke or how harshly he spoke, nothing could move Xiaocai's stubborn little head, and he could only watch helplessly as she walked and crooked all the way under the influence of her senior brothers and sisters.
"Ugh, senior brother, I can't teach you, I can't teach you..." Penglai couldn't bear the torment in his heart anymore and ran directly to his senior brother to cry.
"...Go and bring Xiaoliu here." He never thought that Penglai, who was already very good at raising children, would be stumped by a little baby.
